result.instructions: Tools for Facturapi, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which invoices from this month are still unpaid, and what is the total?"; "Find the customer with RFC XAXX010101000 and show their details."; "Create a draft invoice for customer cus_123 with two units of product prd_456.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Facturapi data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run facturapi_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run facturapi_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run facturapi_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. facturapi_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: facturapi_get_organization
tools.title: Get the organization
tools.description: Get the organization that owns this API key: legal name, tax id (RFC), tax regime, environment, and settings. Good first call to confirm which company the key controls. Facturapi API: GET /organizations/me.

tools.name: facturapi_list_customers
tools.title: List customers
tools.description: Search or list the organization's customers (receivers of invoices) with legal name, RFC, tax system and email. Facturapi API: GET /customers.

q.description: Free-text search (name, RFC, folio, UUID, and so on).

tools.name: facturapi_get_customer
tools.title: Get a customer
tools.description: Get one customer by id, including RFC, legal name, tax system, address and default invoice use. Facturapi API: GET /customers/{customer_id}.

tools.name: facturapi_list_products
tools.title: List products
tools.description: Search or list the organization's products and services (catalog items used on invoices) with description, product key, price, unit and taxes. Facturapi API: GET /products.

q.description: Free-text search (name, RFC, folio, UUID, and so on).

tools.name: facturapi_get_product
tools.title: Get a product
tools.description: Get one product by id, including its SAT product key, unit key, price and tax settings. Facturapi API: GET /products/{product_id}.

tools.name: facturapi_search_product_keys
tools.title: Search SAT product keys
tools.description: Search the SAT product and service key catalog (clave prodserv), needed to create a product. Use the returned key as product_key. Facturapi API: GET /catalogs/products.

q.description: Words to search for, in Spanish or English (for example 'software' or 'servicios').

tools.name: facturapi_search_units
tools.title: Search SAT unit keys
tools.description: Search the SAT measurement unit catalog (clave unidad), needed for a product's unit_key. Facturapi API: GET /catalogs/units.

q.description: Words to search for, in Spanish or English (for example 'pieza' or 'hora').

tools.name: facturapi_list_invoices
tools.title: List invoices
tools.description: List or search CFDI invoices: folio, customer, total, payment status, SAT UUID and date. Filter by date range, customer, type, payment status or series. Facturapi API: GET /invoices.

q.description: Free-text search (name, RFC, folio, UUID, and so on).

customer.description: Only invoices of this customer id.

type.description: CFDI type: I income, E expense, P payment, N payroll, T transfer.

payment_status.description: Only paid or only unpaid invoices.

payment_method.description: PUE paid at issue, PPD paid later.

uuid.description: Only the invoice with this SAT UUID.

date_from.description: Only items on or after this date (yyyy-mm-dd or ISO date-time).

date_to.description: Only items on or before this date (yyyy-mm-dd or ISO date-time).

tools.name: facturapi_get_invoice
tools.title: Get an invoice
tools.description: Get one invoice by id: status, folio, SAT UUID, customer, items, totals, payment status and cancellation status. Facturapi API: GET /invoices/{invoice_id}.

tools.name: facturapi_get_invoice_download_url
tools.title: Get an invoice download link
tools.description: Get a temporary download URL for an invoice file: PDF, XML or ZIP (PDF and XML). Facturapi API: GET /invoices/{invoice_id}/download-url/{format}.

tools.name: facturapi_list_receipts
tools.title: List e-receipts
tools.description: List or search e-receipts (non-fiscal sales receipts that a customer can later convert to an invoice). Filter by date range or customer. Facturapi API: GET /receipts.

q.description: Free-text search (name, RFC, folio, UUID, and so on).

customer.description: Only receipts of this customer id.

payment_form.description: SAT payment form code, two digits (for example '03').

date_from.description: Only items on or after this date (yyyy-mm-dd or ISO date-time).

date_to.description: Only items on or before this date (yyyy-mm-dd or ISO date-time).

tools.name: facturapi_get_receipt
tools.title: Get an e-receipt
tools.description: Get one e-receipt by id, including its items, total, customer and whether it was invoiced. Facturapi API: GET /receipts/{receipt_id}.

tools.name: facturapi_create_customer
tools.title: Create a customer
tools.description: Create a customer (invoice receiver) with legal name, RFC, SAT tax system and postal code. Creates a record only; nothing is sent or stamped. Facturapi API: POST /customers.

legal_name.description: Legal name, as registered with the SAT.

tax_id.description: RFC (tax id), for example 'XAXX010101000' for the generic public.

tax_system.description: SAT tax regime code, for example '601'.

zip.description: Five-digit postal code of the customer's fiscal address.

tools.name: facturapi_create_product
tools.title: Create a product
tools.description: Create a product or service for invoices, with its SAT product key, price and unit. Use facturapi_search_product_keys and facturapi_search_units first. Facturapi API: POST /products.

description.description: Product or service description, as it appears on the invoice.

product_key.description: SAT product and service key (clave prodserv), for example '01010101'.

tax_included.description: true when the price already includes taxes (default true).

unit_key.description: SAT unit key (clave unidad), for example 'H87' for piece (default H87).

unit_name.description: Unit name shown on the invoice, for example 'Pieza'.

sku.description: Your own SKU for this product.

tools.name: facturapi_create_draft_invoice
tools.title: Create a draft invoice
tools.description: Create a DRAFT CFDI invoice for an existing customer and existing products. A draft is not stamped and not sent to the SAT; review it in the Facturapi dashboard before stamping there. Facturapi API: POST /invoices with status 'draft'.

customer_id.description: Id of an existing customer (use facturapi_list_customers).

product_id.description: Id of an existing product (use facturapi_list_products).

items.description: Invoice lines, one per product (up to 2000 here; the API allows 5000).

payment_form.description: SAT payment form code, two digits (for example '03').

payment_method.description: PUE paid at issue, PPD paid later.

use.description: SAT CFDI use code, for example 'G03'.

conditions.description: Payment terms text shown on the invoice.

external_id.description: Your own reference for this invoice.

idempotency_key.description: Key to avoid creating the same draft twice on a retry.

prompts.name: getting_started
prompts.title: Get started with Facturapi
prompts.description: What you can do with Facturapi here, with example requests to try.
